records.text: In 2019 Erika Kirk filed a trademark for her fashion brand while also pursuing a master's degree at Liberty University and beginning a real-estate career with The Corcoran Group.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And then if you look up and you look up the LLCs, certainly as being of 2019, she files for a trademark for that fashion brand. So she is both running a fashion brand, getting her master's at Liberty University, getting her real estate license and beginning a career with Corcoran Real Estate, which is a massive real estate firm in New York.

verification.notes: USPTO records show Erika Frantzve filed PROCLAIM STREETWEAR on January 2, 2019. Contemporary biographical reporting says she completed her Liberty Juris Master in May 2019 after two years of study, while license data places her Corcoran real-estate career from October 2018. The compound timeline is supported, though 'beginning' spans late 2018 into early 2019.

records.text: Before meeting Charlie Kirk, Erika Kirk had her own company, which she still owns, and built it so it could run on its own after she married and had children.
records.speaker: Erika Kirk

appearances.snippet: You know I get this question too of well you know you were a stay-at-home mom and all this stuff like that's what you should go back to doing or something like that a lot of people don't realize that before I met Charlie (Charlie Kirk) I had my own company and I still do and it was one of those things where I built it in a way where that when I got married and had children, it could run on its own.

verification.notes: Transcript confirms Erika made the claim. USPTO records list first use of PROCLAIM STREETWEAR on December 13, 2018 and first commercial use on December 28, after the stated September 2018 first date; the LLC was filed in January 2019. Current records confirm the business exists and Erika owns the mark, but do not establish that it was self-running before marriage.

records.text: Erika Kirk acquired the proclaimstreetwear.com domain on October 26, 2018, one month after her first official date with Charlie Kirk.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: She actually picked up the domain name to that streetwear company, which is proclaimstreetwear.com, the month after on October 26th, 2018.

verification.notes: The episode states an October 26, 2018 domain-acquisition date, but current public search did not yield an authoritative WHOIS record preserving registrant identity and creation date. USPTO records establish later trademark use dates, not the domain acquisition fact.

records.text: Erika Kirk received her New York real-estate license two days before acquiring the Proclaim Streetwear domain, a few weeks after meeting Charlie Kirk.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And it's just two days after she received her real estate license in New York. All of this happening a few weeks after she meets Charlie (Charlie Kirk).

verification.notes: A public license index reports Erika Frantzve's New York salesperson license expired October 24, 2020, consistent with a two-year license issued October 24, 2018. However, the asserted October 26 domain acquisition could not be independently established, so the two-day comparison remains only partly supported.

sources.title: Frantzve Erika - New York real estate license index
sources.relevance: Lists license number, employer, and October 24, 2020 expiration supporting an October 2018 licensing timeline.

records.text: Proclaim Streetwear did not file its LLC paperwork until January 2019, after Erika Kirk began dating Charlie Kirk.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: In October, Proclaimed did not actually file to become a business until January of 2019. In 19, after she began dating Charlie (Charlie Kirk), that's when she formed the official LLC paperwork.

verification.notes: Arizona Corporation Commission-derived records show PROCLAIM Ventures LLC filed January 14, 2019, after Erika and Charlie's stated September 2018 first date. The official USPTO application also was filed January 2, 2019 and claims first use in December 2018.

sources.title: Proclaim Ventures LLC Arizona filing information
sources.relevance: Reports ACC document number 1938928 and January 14, 2019 filing date.

records.text: The earliest Wayback Machine evidence that Proclaim Streetwear offered clothing for sale is January 16, 2021.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: That's the earliest indication on Wayback Machine that clothing items were actually available for sale on the website.

verification.notes: A live search did not surface a stable Internet Archive capture index proving January 16, 2021 was the first snapshot with clothing for sale. Wayback coverage is incomplete and the earliest available capture would not necessarily prove first commercial availability.

sources.title: Internet Archive Help - Using the Wayback Machine
sources.relevance: Explains archive coverage limitations relevant to why an earliest capture does not prove earliest sale.

records.text: Erika Kirk married Charlie Kirk in May 2021 and released the associated Bible 365 app on September 20, 2021.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: That's what happened. She married Charlie (Charlie Kirk) in May. Later that year in September, in September 20th to be particular on September 20th, she's going to release an associated app called Bible 365.

verification.notes: Public biographical reporting places the marriage in May 2021, with multiple sources giving May 8. App-store index data gives BIBLEin365's first release as September 20, 2021 and identifies it with PROCLAIM and Erika Kirk.
